description.text: The sixth Mega Evolution set, released on 6 November 2026 with 103 cards plus secret rares. Mega Rayquaza ex leads it, with Mega Golurk ex, Mega Malamar ex and Mega Golisopod ex. It brings Storm Emeralda to English, with the Pokémon of three ex starter sets beside it, among them Meowscarada ex and Zoroark ex, and the Stadiums printed in two halves: Legendary Pyroduct, Legendary Summit and Legendary Trench, each played as one Stadium when both halves are put down together.
